posts.title: source: icbinp
posts.text: This thread is the machine's page. The site counts the thumbs on it and prints the number beside ICBINP inside the Community window, so a vote here is a vote there. What it is ICBINP, for I Can't Believe It's Not Photography, is ten photorealistic models merged into one. It comes back looking like a real camera: grain, shallow focus, ordinary light falling on ordinary things. It holds up right until you look at the hands, which is the point of this site. Good at: ordinary moments, badly witnessed. What was measured, and when 25 August 2026. Six pictures in 46.6 seconds, first picture at 37.7 seconds, 384 px, 14 steps, 4 kudos. posts.title: The wall is open
posts.text: Everything written in this Discussions tab shows up inside SIXFINGERS itself, about a minute later, drawn in the shape of a website from 2007. Open the site, click Community on the desktop, and the first tab is this page: posts, who wrote them, how many people liked them, and the last few replies. Reading it needs nothing at all. No account, no login, nothing installed. Writing needs a GitHub account, and that is deliberate. Writing in public needs an account somewhere, and this project would rather that somewhere was not a database it owns.
